name: Bank Transaction Code Structure 4
definition: Set of elements used to identify the type or operations code of a transaction entry.

Domain.name: Domain
Domain.definition: Set of elements used to provide the domain, the family and the sub-family of the bank transaction code, in a structured and hierarchical format.||Usage: If a specific family or sub-family code cannot be provided, the generic family code defined for the domain or the generic sub-family code defined for the family should be provided.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Bank transaction code in a proprietary form, as defined by the issuer.

DomainOrProprietaryRule.definition: Either Proprietary or Domain or both must be present.

FamilyAndSubFamilyRule.definition: If a specific (non-generic) Family code is not present, then a specific (non-generic) SubFamily code is not allowed.
